## Reviewer approval checklist
- [ ] Relevant CODEOWNER has reviewed
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated
- [ ] No secrets, student data, or license violations
- [ ] Backward-compatible migration or ADR documented

## AI Agent skill and role compliance
- [ ] Responsible role/skill IDs and independent reviewer named
- [ ] Read relevant `AGENTS.md`, charter and skill instructions
- [ ] UI follows KingDragonHub tokens, typography, icon and copy requirements (if relevant)
- [ ] DB/migration, privacy/child policy and MCP privileges reviewed (if relevant)
- [ ] Tests/visuals/exports were actually run; untested status disclosed
- [ ] R3/R4 change has explicit authorized human approval before production
- [ ] No claim of background automation without a configured scheduler
